range_method: Weighted 0.05th and 99.95th marginal percentiles separately on each local coordinate; uniform equal-area histogram cells. Rectangle does not necessarily contain exactly 99.9% joint mass.
caveats: Histogram density ranks depend on grid resolution and bin origin; these are descriptive joint checks, not a calibrated sky-coverage measurement.
The small-angle local chart uses cos(dec_truth); the sampled high-weight sky patch is small, but this is not a full-sphere density estimator.
Using normalized nested weights is essential; the unweighted prior-like low-likelihood points are not posterior density.
The covariance ellipse is a Gaussian descriptive approximation and cannot exclude unobserved modes or establish sampler mixing.
No KDE, new likelihood evaluation, or GPU work was performed.
The added termination and polarization checks use only the saved posterior and configuration; no new likelihood is evaluated.
The exact polarization symmetry motivates equal target branch mass but does not establish a Monte Carlo significance for the observed imbalance.

weight_diagnostics.method: Normalize all retained nested log_weights with scipy.special.logsumexp, then evaluate weighted quantities. No equal-weight resampled posterior is used.

termination_cross_check.method: The sorted retained table has 650 batches of 512 dead points followed by 4096 final live points. Last dead logL equals the maximum birth contour; final live points all exceed it. Sum their normalized saved posterior weights and convert fraction f to -log(1-f). This reconstructs an indicative remaining-evidence increment from exported weights, not the original online integrator statistic.
termination_cross_check.interpretation: Consistent with normal evidence-based termination; exact online stopping statistic cannot be independently reproduced from these summaries alone.

polarization_symmetry_audit.method: In the configured phase-marginalized dominant-mode likelihood, shifting psi by pi/2 changes the sign of detector strain; |complex overlap| and waveform norm remain unchanged. With uniform psi on [0, pi], the two symmetry branches have equal target mass. Assign branches by nearest injected orientation modulo pi and also fold offsets modulo pi/2.
polarization_symmetry_audit.interpretation: Both symmetry modes are populated. Full-pi equal-tail intervals misleadingly span two narrow modes; present both modes or use the folded orientation. Observed 55/45 branch weights do not prove correct mode mixing; weight ESS cannot calibrate their uncertainty.
